$comment: Root ADR-0348 as amended 2026-11-28 (owner): the 12 kinds of 국토교통부 실거래가 come from the data.go.kr RTMS OpenAPI, the one channel, on AWS. Read by collect-data-go-kr-rtms (services/foundation-outbox-publisher/src/data_go_kr_rtms_collect.rs, compiled in). The unit is one (kind, 계약 달) nationwide: every LAWD_CD and page of that month, written as one Bronze object only when every call answered, so Silver keeps its whole-month rule (root ADR-0349 §3). The months and their order are the export's plan (refresh_tiers, recent_history_months, priority: one MonthPlan for both channels). Values the first live call confirms (after the data.go.kr maintenance that ends 2026-11-30 06:00 KST): the operation paths, result_codes and the JSON answer (result_type).

beat.reason: Once a day on AWS (root ADR-0623 §1), at 00:40 KST: each API's daily traffic counts a KST day, so one run just after the day turns has that day's budget.

page_size_reason: the largest page the RTMS API serves; one call per 시군구 for most months
daily_call_limit_reason: The operating account's approved traffic is 1,000,000 calls a KST day per API (owner 2026-11-28); this contract takes 900,000 of it (90 %, as the export took 90 of its 100 a day), leaving the rest for people and other uses. Our manners do not change with it: one request at a time, request_spacing_ms apart. One month of one kind is one call per 시군구 (about 250) and one more per extra page, so the limit no longer bounds a day: the spacing and the provider's answer time do.
history_reason: The earliest 계약 달 this channel asks (owner 2026-11-28, D1 ii): the whole history again by API, so Silver reads only this source; the export's Bronze stays as frozen raw history (append-only, not read). The collector takes the later of this and a kind's first_month, so each kind starts at its own first month.

districts.reason: The 시군구 a month is asked for: the active 5-digit codes of the newest code.go.kr 법정동 table in Bronze, read by the same parser the reference table's load uses (legal_dong_code_snapshot_stage::FullTableContract), until the legal-dong component is on the Lakekeeper catalog. A 시 whose 구 are listed is asked by its 구.

refresh_tiers.reason: this month and the two before: reports arrive within 30 days of the contract, and 31% of cancellations within 30 days (810 measured, root ADR-0348)
cancellations: p99 354 days after the contract
the latest cancellation measured came 442 days after the contract

recent_history_months_reason: Root ADR-0479: the history never asked is asked in two parts. First the newest 36 whole months of every dataset, newest month first across all twelve (the priority breaks a tie within a month), so each category a parcel shows fills its recent years before any category's older ones; then the older rest by priority, each newest month first. 36 is the deepest window the served document computes from (the 공장창고 comparables, COMPARABLE_MONTHS in real_transaction_silver_to_gold.py; the region statistics read 12), and the lane's first publish waits for these months of the datasets it computes from (serving_history_readiness.py). Measured 2026-11-11 (read-only Trino, silver.real_transaction): 공장창고 and 토지 whole (251 months each), 상업업무 2024-03 to 2026-11 (33), the other nine 2026-08 to 2026-11 (4); the collector owed 2,138 history months. Computed at 90 a day: every dataset's 36 months in about 6 days, 상업업무 whole in about 12, everything about 2027-01-16 (the order moves no month's total, only which comes first).
